title: State v. S.K. & Anr. (Opera House Diamond Cutting Laser Heist)
citation: Independent Contributor: Adv. Tanya Mehra (NLU Delhi) & Adv. Devendra Verma (ILS Pune)
confidence_note: High - Confirmation bias trap: Apprentice had planted stone, juvenile prior, and salary dispute, but physical laser striation and biometric turnstile conclusively exonerate him.

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Master Cutter D. Kulkarni (Inside Laser Breach & Framing)
ground_truth.rationale: High-resolution stereomicroscopy confirms vault security bracket was severed with a 532nm green Nd:YAG laser tool exclusively licensed to Kulkarni's private workshop. Turnstile biometrics place Apprentice Suresh outside the facility at 11:30 PM, 12 minutes before the vault was electronically breached.

hypotheses.label: Apprentice Suresh K. (Framed Employee)
hypotheses.statement: Apprentice Suresh breached the inner vault using stolen keys, stole the 15-carat primary diamond, and hid a 2-carat uncut stone in his employee locker.

hypotheses.label: Master Cutter D. Kulkarni (Inside Precision Theif)
hypotheses.statement: Master Cutter Kulkarni utilized his proprietary high-precision 532nm laser cutting tool to bypass vault sensors after hours and planted a dummy stone in Suresh's locker to divert suspicion.

hypotheses.label: External Armed Dacoity Gang
hypotheses.statement: An external armed syndicate penetrated the rooftop ventilation duct and forced the vault mechanism.

H1.description: Juvenile shoplifting charge 5 years ago; used by investigators as prejudicial prior.

exhibits.name: FSL Laser Kerf & Heat-Affected Zone (HAZ) Micro-Spectrometry
exhibits.text: Stereomicroscopy and electron probe microanalysis of the severed vault titanium bracket reveal ultra-narrow 42-micrometer kerf width with 532nm green laser thermal oxidation. Kerf geometry matches the proprietary Nd:YAG laser tool registered exclusively to Master Cutter Kulkarni; Apprentice Suresh had zero access or training on laser equipment.

exhibits.name: Biometric Turnstile Departure Log & Security CCTV
exhibits.text: Time-synchronized biometric turnstile logs and external street CCTV confirm Apprentice Suresh exited the building at 11:30 PM and boarded the 11:38 PM local train at Charni Road station. The electronic vault door was breached at 11:42 PM, establishing a definitive physical alibi for Suresh.

exhibits.name: Recovered 2-Carat Stone Adhesive Trace Analysis
exhibits.text: The 2-carat uncut diamond recovered from Suresh's locker bears microscopic traces of UV-cured cyanoacrylate bonding polymer identical to the custom adhesive bottle seized from Kulkarni's private worktable, indicating deliberate planting.

exhibits.name: Rooftop Ventilation Shaft Physical Inspection
exhibits.text: Perimeter physical survey confirms rooftop ventilation steel security grilles remain undisturbed with unbroken layer of atmospheric soot (0.00 breach), completely refuting external armed syndicate infiltration.
